concept: A detachable clerical sidecar beside an intact human-care room.
title: The Care Has to Stay

fingerprint.metaphor: Detachable clerical sidecar beside a continuous care platform

divergence_note: Unlike September 2's vertical credential press in an institutional parchment world and September 1's radial space-signal machinery, this film crosses a sunlit human room, overhead artifact wells and a source-notice model. The center of gravity is an intact relationship, not a seal or a signal.

hook.frame1: Large poised recording switch surrounded by a curling paper wave; room outcome concealed.
hook.headline: CAN YOU TELL THE MACHINE NO?
hook.loopback: The same lever finally rests OFF while the two people keep facing each other.
